functionEntry.name: onPhone
functionEntry.documentation:
Phone → watch. One small dictionary per second while the phone is connected to the ECU:
{"rpm", "afr" (×10), "tgt" (×10), "tps", "gear", "pulls", "map", "lean" (0/1), "bpw" (×100)}

functionEntry.name: tick
functionEntry.documentation: Periodic watch → phone: heart rate (for the drowsiness score) and recording state.

functionEntry.name: mark
functionEntry.documentation: A "feel" marker: lap in the FIT + a timestamped message to the phone ("flat spot here").
